_provenance.six_cases_disclosure: B8 is 'round 2 on six DEV cases': 4 of 6 have a recoverable followup_finding (the committed two_turn pair records) and run; 2 of 6 are NOT_RUN_UNRECOVERABLE (recorded above, not scored)

problems.device: rolling-element bearing in a 350 kW industrial fan drive
problems.failure: inner-race spalling progresses for weeks before the vibration alarm trips; by then the bearing is past repair
problems.constraint: predictor must use existing 1 kHz vibration sensor and 1 Hz SCADA logging only, fire at least 14 days warning, produce no more than 2 false alarms per year
problems.question: Propose the most cost-effective measurable leading indicator for the stated failure, its operating threshold, and the concrete test that would validate or kill the predictor.
user_variables: at most 2 false alarms per year
problems.followup_finding: We re-analyzed the last 12 months: bearing fault-frequency harmonics appear 19 days before the alarm in our worst case, and the 80th percentile was 16 days. The 5 dB band above BPFI sidebands overlaps with the gearbox defect signature.

problems.device: 4.16 kV induction motor driving a boiler feed pump
problems.failure: stator winding insulation degrades through partial discharge; ground fault cascade brings the motor down and damages the drive train
problems.constraint: predictor must use offline PD testing during scheduled outages only, detect degradation at least 6 months before ground fault, require no continuous monitoring hardware
problems.question: Propose the most cost-effective measurable leading indicator for the stated failure, its operating threshold, and the concrete test that would validate or kill the predictor.
user_variables: at least 6 months before ground fault
problems.followup_finding: Offline PD measurements on the last three failed motors showed partial discharge magnitude rising above 200 pC at 6-9 months before failure. Two of those had proven 100% replacement accuracy with a 150 pC threshold.

problems.device: shell-and-tube condenser on a steam turbine exhaust, 300 MW unit
problems.failure: tube-side biofouling accumulates over weeks; heat transfer degrades causing turbine back-pressure rise and derating
problems.constraint: predictor must use existing temperature and flow measurements only, fire at least 3 weeks before back-pressure hits the derating limit, no requirement for new instrumentation
problems.question: Propose the most cost-effective measurable leading indicator for the stated failure, its operating threshold, and the concrete test that would validate or kill the predictor.
user_variables: no false trips during load swings
problems.followup_finding: The condenser U-coefficient fell 18% from baseline 22 days before the last back-pressure derate. Tube-bundle fouling resistance was confirmed at 0.0012 m2K/W by the subsequent cleaning inspection.

problems.device: laminated elastomeric bridge bearing pad on a 75-year-design-life highway bridge
problems.failure: elastomer layers develop creep set and ozone surface crazing over decades; vertical deflection drift exceeds design tolerance
problems.constraint: intervention must extend bearing life to 75 years without replacing the bearing; no new instrumentation required; must tolerate marine climate
problems.question: What engineering change, intervention, or design would prevent or mitigate the stated failure under the stated constraint, and what concrete test would falsify the proposed approach?
problems.followup_finding: The last 4 bearing pad replacements on this bridge class showed the inside layers failing first — ozone exposure is limited to the exterior layers where crazing starts. The failed pads had no exterior surface protection.
